list_templates: list all available FastMCP server template names via --list flag
run_scaffold_api_wrapper: run scaffold_fastmcp.py to generate an API wrapper FastMCP server from the api_wrapper template
run_scaffold_database_server: run scaffold_fastmcp.py to generate a SQLite database FastMCP server from the database_server template
run_scaffold_file_processor: run scaffold_fastmcp.py to generate a file processing FastMCP server from the file_processor template
render_template: render a FastMCP template with a custom server name replacing the __SERVER_NAME__ placeholder
